name: Pinny's Simple SMTP
author: Pinny Fried

sections.description:
Pinny’s Simple SMTP is a lightweight, zero-bloat SMTP plugin for WordPress. It allows you to easily configure SMTP settings and send test emails without any unnecessary features. Ideal for users who want a simple, fast, and efficient solution for email delivery.

Features:

Easy SMTP setup

Send test emails with one click

Lightweight and bloat-free

Fully compatible with WordPress

Perfect for users who need a no-frills SMTP solution!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin

    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New, and click Upload Plugin.
    • Choose the ZIP file you downloaded and click Install Now.

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Once installed, click Activate to enable Pinny’s Simple SMTP.

  3. Configure SMTP Settings

    • Go to Settings > Pinny’s SMTP in the admin menu.
    • Enter your SMTP host, port, and other settings.
    • Save your changes.

  4. Send a Test Email

    • Enter a test email address and click Send Test Email to verify your SMTP configuration.
